editorial:
Imagine waking up on a Saturday morning in the mid-eighties, pouring a bowl of cereal, and flipping on the TV. That is exactly the feeling you get with this special. It is a high-energy preview show hosted by the wonderful Joyce Dewitt, who brings a ton of charm and warmth to the screen. The whole vibe is bright, loud, and full of that classic 80s excitement. It is less like a movie and more like a time machine that takes you back to a world of colorful costumes and big smiles, all designed to get you pumped up for the new season of kids' shows.

What really works here is the fast pacing and the sheer joy of the presentation. You will love seeing how they used to market TV shows before the internet existed. While it is mostly a promotional piece, the energy is infectious. If you miss the gold age of Saturday morning cartoons, you have to check this out. Since this is a rare gem, you might want to look for it on archival streaming sites or hunt down a physical VHS copy for your collection to get that authentic grainy look. It is a perfect pick for a lazy weekend afternoon with the family.
endingExplained: The special wraps up by giving you one final, exciting look at all the shows coming to CBS. After all the clips and interviews, Joyce Dewitt gives a warm send-off to the viewers. She encourages everyone to tune in every single week so they do not miss a moment of the action. It ends on a high note with bright music and a final goodbye, leaving you feeling eager to watch the actual cartoons.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s nostalgia and classic TV history.
